text_en: In 2026 the World Bank experts' assessment of ARCOM's internal processes is due to be completed, with joint recommendations on organisational and system optimisation to align the institution with European regulator practice, including the wider role and functions of ARCOM under the European framework. These recommendations will form the basis of a plan to reform and optimise the Agency's organisation and internal processes.

name: Draft law amending Law No. 273/1994 on identity documents (new electronic identity card)
text_en: Also, the PSA has developed a draft law to amend Law No. 273/1994 regarding identity documents obtained from the national passport system, which was sent to the State Chancellery on 16 August 2023 for approval and promotion.
